summary: Thomson Reuters filed a Form 6-K reporting Q1 2026 results and disclosed a completed $605 million return of capital transaction on May 4 via a share consolidation reducing share count by 6.5 million shares, representing a 10% annualized dividend increase to $2.62 announced in February, and $262 million in open-market repurchases under a $600 million program authorized Feb 25, 2026. The board maintains its 2026 outlook. No tender offer or share buyback by issuer was launched in this filing; the filing simply reports executed capital returns. The transaction reduced float by roughly 4% based on prior outstanding shares. Watch for continued execution of the remaining repurchase authorization and potential further capital return initiatives.
